The Message

Prayer Was Never Meant to Be Just a Routine.

The Book

Weapons Grade Prayer

by Tommy Scribbins

Drawing on Scripture, the life of David, and his own experiences with prayer, Tommy Scribbins invites readers to reconsider familiar approaches to prayer and discover a more personal practice of praise, intimacy, and connection with God.

This is not a book of formulas. It is an invitation to move past mechanical repetition and into a living, honest conversation with your Creator — one rooted in gratitude, trust, and the promises of Scripture.

The Author

Meet Tommy Scribbins

Tommy Scribbins writes from his own journey with prayer — a path that led him to question familiar routines and seek a more honest, personal way to honor God.

Drawing on Scripture and the life of David, he explores how praise, gratitude, and trust can reshape an everyday prayer life. Weapons Grade Prayer grew out of that search: an invitation for readers to discover a deeper connection with their Creator.
